title: Terrain / Warthog and expansion
goal: Check forward/back camera jitter while driving at 120 FPS. Vehicle rendering and both cameras now follow the same interpolated physics pose. Use F8 to capture any remaining jitter.
changes: Same Warthog source model, articulated suspension, physics tuning and saved camera configuration as the previous terrain workshop. Terrain extends within the native DEM coverage, keeps a bounded area resident and preserves collision-supply safeguards. New mesh uploads and collision creation are paced separately. Weapons, trees, backdrop and expanded lighting remain later stages.
controls: WASD drive; Space brake; C chase/driver camera; hold RMB to look; Home centres look. E switches between driving and inspection flight. R places the Warthog upright on loaded ground at its current location. F5 opens the existing vehicle setup; F2 opens this brief. In flight: WASD, Space/Ctrl vertical, Shift faster. Enter starts when ready. F8 starts/stops jitter capture, including the preceding five seconds of suspension, contact, camera and frame history. Logs are saved automatically.
